decisions.reason: The request transfers one specified NFT or affiliate code to a wallet but does not change which book, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket state follows an NFT upon transfer.
Ownership of code #27 changes as instance data, but the general rule that a coded-referral commission belongs to the referrer associated with the code remains unchanged.
The transfer of a specified affiliate code does not change the amount, trigger, or weighted recipient selection for commissions on mints without a referral code.

The ownership transfer may determine which wallet satisfies the existing holder check, but it does not change the NFT-holder eligibility rule, Lit Protocol configuration, or automatic ownership check.
The source requests an ownership transfer and does not modify the rule that only finalized successful mints may be counted or represented as minted NFTs.
The specified ownership transfer does not change mobile-wallet signature handling or mobile ebook loading behavior.
Transferring ownership of code #27 does not change the general ticket quantity, promotional-mint exclusion, or rule assigning coded-referral tickets to the NFT associated with the code.
The source requests a specific ownership transfer but does not request any revision to the approved FAQ copy or its transfer and referral-code explanations.
Ownership of a specified affiliate code does not change ticket issuance or recipient selection for mints made without a referral code.
The transfer request does not alter the mint price, affiliate commission amount, founder share, or prize-pool allocation.
The requested NFT or affiliate-code transfer is independent of the deferred Transak provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, and fiat mint destination rules.
The source does not modify optional gratuity availability, amounts, transaction handling, or the delayed follow-up notice.
